title: the eval driver's --allowedTools grant list is passed as ONE space-containing argv element, but the CLI documents space-separated SEPARATE arguments -- the four Bash(...) matchers each carry an internal space and cannot survive a split, so the containment posture evals/README.md:87-97 documents is very likely not the posture in force (fail-closed direction: phases stall on an unanswerable Bash prompt and burn the 2700s timeout)

CA-499 STILL OPEN: #!/bin/bash is the sole hardcoded interpreter path among 14 production/eval scripts (all others #!/usr/bin/env bash), on the one script hooks.json:86 routes ALL commit-time enforcement through -- exec status 126 is non-blocking under the hook contract, so a host without /bin/bash silently loses artifact enforcement; also splits bash 3.2 vs 5.x inside one check on macOS. No rationale comment at :1 and no divergence-sweep assertion
